proposed_comments.title: Resolve the installer path from the Windows environment
proposed_comments.body:
### Resolve the installer path from the Windows environment

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking path portability: derive the standard Visual Studio Installer location from `${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}` instead of fixing its drive and Program Files directory in this command. This retains the installer-shipped `vswhere.exe` and all existing discovery flags; it does not switch to a PATH executable, install tools, or claim that the current hosted image fails. The original and replacement commands returned the same installation paths on the validation machine.

```suggestion
        $vsInstalls = & (Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe') -all -prerelease -products * -property installationPath
```
